tasks.short: Implement enhanced processing, testing or manufacturing methods for nanotechnology materials or products.

steps.what: Check current approved nanotechnology method, equipment recipe and batch requirements using native version links
inputs: actual approved new method
actual equipment and batch requirements
outputs: technician-checked method version and implementation requirements

steps.what: Prepare actual materials and equipment to implement the approved enhanced nanoscale method
inputs: technician-checked method version and implementation requirements
actual approved materials and equipment
outputs: actual prepared method implementation setup

steps.what: Implement the actual processing, testing or manufacturing method and observe deviations
inputs: actual prepared method implementation setup
actual engineering supervision and authorised operating conditions
outputs: actual method implementation results and deviations

steps.what: Write and approve actual method version, run conditions, findings and deviations
inputs: actual method implementation results and deviations
outputs: approved final actual method implementation record

steps.what: Save the approved actual method implementation record
inputs: approved final actual method implementation record
outputs: saved actual method implementation record

tasks.design: Configure native approved-method and equipment recipe links in {LAB_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER with production equipment. The technician verifies versions and physically implements actual authorised methods under engineering supervision. Actual run records are written and approved before a separate save; no production process control is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current approved method and recipe versions may require repeated manual retrieval.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version links can connect exact approved methods with actual equipment and batches.
tasks.still_hard: Material behaviour, actual setup and deviations during nanoscale processing.
tasks.human_edge: The technician notices when actual process behaviour departs from the approved method.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated method retrieval before actual nanotechnology implementation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory records can link current approved methods and recipes; this configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual approved-method retrieval after current laboratory links; existing recipe control and runtime earn no saving.
Actual method owner supplies method_id, approved_version, equipment_id and batch_scope. s1 retains 7.5 hours for version and scope checking; missing approved references are verified manually.

Physical setup and implementation remain full effort. s4 captures actual batch_id, run_conditions, results and deviations after the run at full time. Final record approval precedes save; changes void approval. Same-system save earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which approved method and recipe retrieval remains manual before implementation?

incremental.description: Maintain actual approved method and equipment reference links

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final actual method implementation record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only method retrieval changes: 15 times 50% = 7.5 less 0.5 upkeep = 7. Low halves that benefit: 3.75 less 0.5 = 3.25.

tasks.short: Assist scientists or engineers with process specifications and documentation.

steps.what: Verify actual process decisions, engineering instructions and measured results for the specification
inputs: actual engineer or scientist process decisions
actual approved methods and measured results
outputs: technician-verified specification source facts and engineering intent

steps.what: Populate exact specification fields and result tables using native document templates
inputs: technician-verified specification source facts and engineering intent
outputs: candidate exact process specification fields and tables

steps.what: Draft and substantively check process explanations against actual engineering instructions and results
inputs: candidate exact process specification fields and tables
technician-verified specification source facts and engineering intent
outputs: technician-checked complete candidate process specification

loop.purpose: Express actual engineer decisions and variable process observations in specification prose
loop.input: Actual verified process decisions, approved methods, measured results and engineering intent
loop.output: Candidate process explanation with exact source references and unresolved limits
loop.check: Technician checks every process action, sequence, requirement, qualification and omission against actual instructions and results, not only numeric fields
loop.stop: Missing engineering intent or two failed corrections returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields handle fixed values first; variable process explanations require meaning-preserving prose drafting and checking

steps.what: Approve the complete final specification assistance draft and exact engineer review recipient
inputs: technician-checked complete candidate process specification
outputs: approved final specification assistance draft and exact engineer recipient

steps.what: Save the approved final specification assistance draft
inputs: approved final specification assistance draft and exact engineer recipient
outputs: saved final specification assistance draft

steps.what: Send the approved final specification assistance draft to the approved internal engineer
inputs: approved final specification assistance draft and exact engineer recipient
outputs: sent final process specification assistance draft

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} specification fields from actual {LAB_SYSTEM} data, denoted OTHER. Use a bounded loop only for variable prose based on actual engineering instructions, with full meaning checks. The technician approves the complete final assistance draft before separate save and internal engineer send; engineering release remains a later decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual process facts and engineering explanations may be repeatedly composed into specification drafts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exact fields plus bounded source-grounded prose can reduce repeated drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Correct process sequence, engineering intent and limitations of actual results.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows whether wording describes the process actually performed.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated specification drafting with engineering decisions retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact document templates and bounded process prose drafting can prepare candidate assistance documents; this is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual fact copying and explanation writing after existing specification templates; current generated tables and runtime earn no saving.

Actual engineering owner supplies method_id, chosen_process_steps and requirement_intent; actual laboratory records supply result_id, measured_value, units and conditions. s1 retains full source and intent verification. Missing content is clarified manually before drafting; no new engineering capture is assumed.

s3 retains 15 hours for complete meaning checks and correction; s4 retains full combined final review and exact internal recipient approval. Changed text or recipient voids approval. Same-system save earns no benefit; engineer review and release are not counted as saved technician labour.
research_questions: Which actual process facts and explanations are still rewritten for specification assistance?
